newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pacific Andes falls below IPO price.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Andes falls below IPO price.

text.p: Frozen seafood trader Pacific Andes fell below its initial public offer price of US$0.57 on its first day of trading on the Stock Exchange of Singapore on Friday.
It also saw several block trades totalling 800,000 shares at US$0.57 each at the open.
The stock opened at US$0.55 and was trading around US$0.525 at 0121 GMT. Including the block deals, total volume was 2.19 million shares.
"It looks like people who are stagging are trying to hold on for a better price. But they may be forced to sell if the price does not pick up soon," said an institutional dealer.
Dealers said some investors preferred the shares in its parent company, Hong Kong-listed Pacific Andes International Holdings.
